article.hook: Someone just took the stage without asking if they were invited. Jupiter in Leo rolls through like a spotlight, pulling the big-hearted out of the wings and into the center. It’s not subtle - it's a call to stretch what you believe you deserve to show and give.
article.lived: For about a year, you notice people pitching bigger ideas in meetings, not by shrinking the ask but by turning up the volume on their confidence. The office artist volunteers for the mural, the team leader claims the win with full chest, and generosity shows up as open invitations and extra hands when the spotlight’s on. This is a time when bold gestures expand your reach, and the pride behind them makes the difference between noise and magnetism.
article.turn: But the line blurs quickly. The same voice that commands attention can drown out others, and enthusiasm turns into spectacle for its own sake. Watch for the impulse to overplay every move, to mistake size for substance. When ego drives the script, generosity becomes a performance, and the roar just echoes back to you.
moves: Host a gathering where everyone shares a personal win, no edits allowed.
Offer genuine praise to someone who usually works behind the scenes.
Take a creative risk that stretches your usual boundaries, then own the result without apology.
